film: बस तू बाकी है · Night 01 open call
copyRules: Hindi headlines in Modak, English support in Big Shoulders caps (7 words at most), small Hindi in Khand. No dashes, no lyrics. Critical text inside x 64 to 940, y 220 to 1620.

scenes.name: पहला सुर किसका?
scenes.meaning: Whose is the first note? Night 01 is Dhwanikul's first night, so whoever sings first opens the whole kul.
scenes.visualConcept: Darkness, one red thread across the grid line, a cream tag with a blank name hanging from it. A packet hand plucks the thread: the first note is literally played, and the word for note rings with it.
scenes.thread: A string. Plucked on beat 1 (Sa), then three rising plucks on beats 3 to 4 (Re, Ga, Pa) so the question is heard rising and left unresolved.
scenes.typography: पहला सुर (Modak 150) appears on the pluck and vibrates with the string, its headline bar flipping side frame to frame as the thread does, dying away with it. किसका? (Modak 150) lands on beat 4, the question mark dropping in last. English types small under them from beat 3.
scenes.camera: Locked, slightly low. On the last note it starts to push towards the tag's punched hole.
scenes.motion: The tag jolts on each pluck and swings back like a pendulum. The hand is stiff, packet style: in, pull, release, out.
scenes.sound: Silence, then pluck Sa; the tanpura drone fades in under it; Re, Ga, Pa rising, Pa left hanging.
scenes.transitionIn: Cold open on the thread at y 672, so the reel's first frame lines up with the grid.
scenes.transitionOut: The camera follows the thread through the tag's punched hole.
assets: SUNG BY tag with a blank line and a blinking caret
scenes.notes: The first 2 seconds must hook muted viewers too: the Hindi question is the hook, the pluck is the hook for everyone else.

scenes.name: तानसेन की इमली

english: GWALIOR SAYS IT SWEETENED HIS VOICE

scenes.meaning: Gwalior's legend: the tamarind tree at Tansen's tomb, whose leaves singers chew so their voice turns sweet. It is why Dhwanikul's sweet is imli.
scenes.visualConcept: Through the hole, the orange wrapper. The thread draws Tansen's tamarind tree as one continuous line, like the line drawings on old candy wrappers: trunk, branches, a canopy edge of tiny paired leaflets, pods hanging. A few leaves fall.
scenes.thread: A single continuous drawing line. Its head travels and draws; one branch per melody note. It is still the same thread from scene 1.
scenes.typography: तानसेन की इमली (Modak 130) does not pop: it prints in like wrapper ink, its halftone dots growing to solid. The English line types in under it.
scenes.camera: Emerges through the hole (the hole's rim slides past the lens), then a slow pull back that reveals the whole tree.
scenes.motion: The line draws with a slight ease on each branch; leaves flutter down in bar 3 with paper weight (side to side, slowing).
scenes.sound: Drone; Bhupali notes held two beats each (Ga, Re, Sa, low Dha), one per branch; a soft crinkle rustle as the leaves fall.
scenes.transitionOut: On bar 4 beat 1 one pod lets go of the tree.
assets: Tansen's tamarind tree as one path
scenes.notes: Tansen's tree: once per film, as the brand allows. Tamarind leaves: once, here.

scenes.name: Packed for Gwalior

english: SO WE PACKED SOME FOR YOU

scenes.meaning: The legend becomes the product: the pod from Tansen's tree is wrapped and tied, and Dhwanikul is born from it.
scenes.visualConcept: The pod falls. The thread lets go of the tree (the drawing unpicks as the line follows the pod down), loops the pod, the wrapper twists shut around it with a crinkle and the thread ties both twisted ends: it is the tied imli logo, ध on the wrapper. The camera pulls back: it sits at the top of a packet label with the cream border and haldi corner diamonds; the FLAVOUR No. 01 · खट्टा मीठा band drops under it.
scenes.thread: Follows, wraps, ties: one thread running behind the candy from the left tie to the right tie.
scenes.typography: The flavour band lands with weight (Big Shoulders 900 on haldi, Khand for खट्टा मीठा). The English line types at the band's right.
scenes.camera: Drops with the pod, then pulls back to the packet.
scenes.motion: The pod falls under gravity; wrapper snap and overshoot; the knot cinches with the elastic overshoot of the logo film.
scenes.sound: A falling run on the thread (Pa, Ga, Re, Sa); crinkle on the twist; a soft thud and pluck on the knot.
scenes.transitionOut: The tied imli settles as the first ingredient; the camera slides down the label.
assets: the tied imli (logo layers from the logo film)
scenes.notes: The wrapper twisting shut here pairs with it untwisting in scene 7.

scenes.name: INGREDIENTS
scenes.meaning: Everything a performer needs is already packed; the only thing missing is them.
scenes.visualConcept: An ingredients panel in the style of the nutrition facts panel. Each line is written on a downbeat and the thread draws the rule under it, then acts the ingredient out: under 1 SONG it is plucked four times; under AUTOTUNE 0% it goes dead straight and silent for a beat (the joke); under 1 VOICE the dotted leader runs out into nothing and the % column stays empty.
scenes.thread: The underline: it rules each line in turn, rings under the song line, lies dead under autotune, goes slack under the blank voice line.
scenes.typography: Panel lines Big Shoulders 30 to 34 in ink on cream with dotted leaders. बस तू बाकी है (Modak 140) lands on bar 7 beat 1 with a thud, heavy, settling into the panel's blank line like a weight; ONE INGREDIENT MISSING: YOU types under it.
scenes.camera: Slides down from the tied imli to the panel, tracks each new line, a small push on the blank line, then a pull back for the headline.
scenes.motion: Each line writes left to right in under half a second; leaders dot in after it. The heavy headline squashes on landing.
scenes.sound: The groove enters: bar 5 dha and na only, bar 6 the full keherwa, pluck accents on each line, the four notes on the song line, nothing at all under autotune, a crinkle roll at the end of bar 7.
scenes.transitionIn: The camera slides down from the tied imli.
scenes.transitionOut: The dotted leader runs out; the music stops dead.
scenes.notes: Lines stay on screen once written, so they can be read in the scene's 8 seconds even though each arrives on a beat.

scenes.name: The silence
scenes.meaning: The space for your name. Nothing happens until you do.
scenes.visualConcept: Everything stops. The blank tag slides down the slack thread into frame and swings. The caret on its blank line blinks twice. Nothing else moves.
scenes.typography: Only the tag: SUNG BY and the blank line with its blinking ink caret.
scenes.camera: Dead still, the only still camera in the film.
scenes.motion: One pendulum swing of the tag, settling.
scenes.sound: Total silence: no drone, no groove.
scenes.transitionIn: The music cuts on the downbeat.
scenes.notes: The film's one real silence, so the next downbeat hits.

scenes.name: तेरी बारी

english: BRING ONE SONG · WE BRING THE IMLI

scenes.meaning: Your turn. The stage is yours.
scenes.visualConcept: The thread snaps taut to the grid line and yanks the whole packet label off frame like a tablecloth; the tag stays on the thread. Underneath is the dark stage. On beat 4 the haldi light switches on. On bar 9 beat 1 तेरी बारी pops into the light and the tune plays on the thread in full, every note visible as a pluck.
scenes.thread: Taut, then the instrument: it plays the two bar tune, ringing as a standing wave on every note.
scenes.typography: तेरी बारी (Modak 170): the full candy pop, the biggest pop in the film. The English line types under it.
scenes.camera: One jolt with the yank, then a slow push into the light with small kicks on the downbeats.
scenes.motion: The label moves like paper with weight: a short drag, then it is gone in four frames, with no blur. The light comes on with one flicker.
scenes.sound: A loud pluck on the yank with a crinkle swish; a thud as the light comes on; the full groove and the tune from bar 9.
scenes.transitionOut: The tied imli drops into the light.
scenes.notes: This is the proposed hero proof, together with scene 5.

scenes.name: मीठी डोर

english: 1 · EAT THE IMLI BEFORE YOU SING

scenes.meaning: The ritual every performer gets on the night, word for word from the printed मीठी डोर tags: eat the imli before you sing, tie the thread on after, you're kul now.
scenes.visualConcept: Bar 10: the tied imli drops into the light, the wrapper untwists with a crinkle and a bite is taken out of the pod on beat 3. Bar 11: a packet-style wrist comes in, the thread winds twice round it and ties the rakhi knot, loose ends in a V. Bar 12: the camera pulls back along the same thread to the next wrist and the next, five wrists in a row (a kurta cuff, denim, a bangle, a watch, a hoodie), one thread through all of them; the ground turns to warm tamarind PULP.
scenes.thread: Wound round a wrist, tied as a rakhi, then running on through the kul.
scenes.typography: मीठी डोर (Modak 140) is written in as if on the tag. The yellow Modak step numbers 1 and 2 come from the printed tag. YOU'RE KUL NOW in Big Shoulders 44, and the ध्वनि KUL wordmark from the lockup outlines pops on bar 12 beat 3.
scenes.camera: Push into the imli; follow the thread to the wrist; long pull back along the thread across five wrists.
scenes.motion: Wrapper untwist (logo film); the bite snaps with a crumb or two; the wind tightens with elastic overshoot; in PULP everything moves at about two thirds speed.
scenes.sound: Groove; a crunch (crinkle) for the bite; the pitch rises as the thread tightens round the wrist (a tighter string plays higher), then the knot; half time in bar 12 with the drone up and low plucks.
scenes.transitionIn: The imli drops into the light.
scenes.transitionOut: The seal stamps down on bar 13 beat 1.
scenes.notes: PULP appears only here, the film's emotional peak.

scenes.name: PACKED AT · PADHARO SA

english: PACKED AT · PADHARO SA · GWALIOR · NIGHT 01
UNPLUGGED COVERS · COME SING OR COME LISTEN

scenes.meaning: When and where, packed like the Night 01 story: the venue seal, the date, free entry.
scenes.visualConcept: The PACKED AT seal around Padharo Sa's logo drops on the downbeat; its impact turns the PULP ground back to imli orange and the wrists' thread straightens into the grid line at y 672, with तेरी बारी strung on it (the thread runs behind its headline bar). The date block (a haldi Modak 17, as on the story), the venue line and the band assemble around it: the Night 01 label builds itself.
scenes.thread: The grid line, strung behind the headline: the label system's headline on the thread.
scenes.typography: The 17 pops in haldi Modak; SAT and OCTOBER in Big Shoulders 900 ink; the cream band with UNPLUGGED COVERS · COME SING OR COME LISTEN slides in like paper.
scenes.camera: Settles back to the frame's own grid, for the first time since scene 1.
scenes.motion: Seal: fast drop, squash, small rebound, a little ink spread. Pieces arrive on beats, never all at once.
scenes.sound: The biggest thud in the film on the stamp; the full groove; a short return of the tune in bar 14.
scenes.transitionOut: The blank tag swings in on the grid line.
assets: PACKED AT venue seal with Padharo Sa's logo
date block, venue band (from the Night 01 story)

scenes.name: DM TO PERFORM
scenes.meaning: Put your name on the tag.
scenes.visualConcept: The blank tag swings in a last time on the grid line, left; the haldi DM TO PERFORM band drops under the date; the thread ties off with the rakhi knot at the right, loose ends swinging in a V. Hold.
scenes.thread: Tied off: the end of every Dhwanikul film.
scenes.typography: DM TO PERFORM in Big Shoulders 900, ink on a haldi band with an ink outline.
scenes.camera: Still, so the last frame can be the grid cover.
scenes.motion: Tag pendulum; band drop and squash; knot cinch with overshoot.
scenes.sound: The groove drops away to the drone; a thud as the band lands; the final pluck on Sa as the knot ties, ringing out to the end.
scenes.notes: The last frame is the grid cover: thread at y 672, a complete Night 01 label.
